facts.fact: The report states the government established the National KE-CIRT/CC, domiciled at the Communications Authority, launched officially in 2014, coordinating cyber response at national level.
The National KE-CIRT/CC states it issued 20,748,489 cyber threat advisories in April-June 2026.
The National KE-CIRT/CC's 42nd quarterly report gives 2,355,938,192 threat events detected and 20,748,489 advisories issued for April-June 2026, plus 358 digital investigations.
